verdict.rationale: The Fivetran REST API is documented for setting up, scaling, and managing pipelines programmatically. The Connector SDK ships AI coding-agent plugins (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI) to build, test, and deploy connectors from natural-language prompts, and the official MCP server unlocks write operations such as copying connections to new destinations. One community report says the APIs fail randomly, which lowers confidence but does not contradict the capability. Missing for 10: a documented end-to-end headless walkthrough (create destination, connection, and transformation, then trigger sync), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), a general pipeline CLI beyond the Connector SDK, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven pipeline creation.
